exact_binary_proof.proof: Disassembly must show GGML_SYCL_ENABLE_GRAPH loaded with default zero into g_ggml_sycl_enable_graph and graph dispatch branching directly to ordinary compute when that global is zero.

graph_off_attestation.reason: This exact llama-bench suppresses the informational logger in JSON mode; r1 proved that requiring those strings is infeasible, while the exact DSO contains a statically auditable graph gate.

r1_quarantine.preservation: R1's failed terminal receipt, failure record, note, and raw rows remain untouched and quarantined.

quality_boundary.disclosure: Historical same-artifact quality is cited separately and is not transferred to the fresh exact-depth cells.

interpretation.on_pass: Create seven measured raw-engine cells from r2 only for this exact artifact/runtime/config identity; quality remains separately labeled.
